claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market Street offered a free concert every evening.
claims.excerpt:
the world, 619 Market street. Free cencert
every evening.

claims.statement: A notice advertised Tom Allen as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt:
Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of
the world, 619 Market street.

notes: Advertisement only. 'Saloon' comes from the title; the notice does not use the word. 'Cencert' is OCR for 'concert'.
